experiments.title: Workspace emergence under necessity

headline.determinism: a01 reproduced treatment_final=0.048657 control_final=0.045324 exactly from attempt_id alone

limitations: MINIMAL FORM: a 5-gene real-valued policy vector, not a rich program. This shows the ECONOMICS select for retention; it says nothing about what machinery a richer organism would invent.

control_no_retention CANNOT evolve: with A1 disabled every gene is phenotypically inert, so it is a fixed baseline rather than a competing evolutionary process. 'Beats control' is weaker than it sounds; the ancestor-relative contrast (+9.70% mean) and the intervention dependence carry the claim.
4 independent seeds + 1 exact re-run of the original (a01), not 5 independent replicates.

RECURRENCE WAS NOT SWEPT: the effect is established at recurrence 0.35 only. The pre-registration lists the sweep as expansion. The one other point available is the built-in zero-recurrence control, which correctly evolved AWAY from retention (p_write 0.266, persist 10.0) - weak evidence of conditionality.
Interventions I2 (scramble), I3 (sever), I4 (destroy-selected) and I5 (swap) were NOT run; they are expansion. In particular I2 would separate HAVING state from FINDING it, which this attempt cannot.

experiments.title: Ancestral efficiency ratchet

headline.ratchet: NO - p_factor fixes before p_norm in 6/6 runs across 3 selection strengths
headline.mechanism_of_null: T2 profitable without T1, so the foundation is an enhancement not a precondition

limitations: NEUTRAL HITCHHIKING: the neutral control genes are not flat in trajectories (neutral_a +0.111 mean, neutral_b -0.082) because elites are copied wholesale and drag neutral genes along. Q6 still holds (they have no PHENOTYPE), but their drift bounds how finely gene-ordering can be read.

DESIGN: the population converges in under 10 generations (+203.2% within gens 0-9, then -1.6% to +3.0% for 70 generations). A ratchet requires time-separated discoveries; this world yields everything at once. That is the finding that most constrains e02.
The detection floor and the ordering bar remain: a ratchet below 12.3% lift would be invisible regardless.

RESOLUTION (updated): largely discharged by the selection-strength probe -- at the weakest setting the p_factor/p_norm gap is 12-13 generations, an order of magnitude beyond the original ~1-2 generation ambiguity. Neutral drift remains substantial (up to -0.399) and is reported alongside.

DESIGN CONSEQUENCE: to test a ratchet, the foundation must be USELESS alone AND REQUIRED for the later gain. Here it is merely cheaper-together. A future design must make T2 impossible (not just expensive) without T1 -- that is a change to the ECONOMICS and belongs in a new pre-registration, not an amendment to this one.

experiments.title: Micro-MoE / sparse computational coalitions

headline.key_control: non-conditional evolved arm MI 0.0000 with 1 distinct pattern - maximally sparse and completely blind; the estimator separates sparsity from coalition on EVOLVED populations

limitations: Sparsity and conditionality are separate quantities. A sparse, blind population is a NEGATIVE for the coalition claim however elegant it looks.
MI is biased upward at this sample size (raw MI ~0.14 bits on independent data); only the excess over the shuffled null is evidence.
An 82-parameter linear activation policy, not a rich program.

factory_findings_so_far: The job contract is Redis-free: fn(ctx, **kwargs) with a 5-method ctx. localrun.py makes that a shipped contract instead of something每 caller re-invents in tests.

Reusing the full fabric would have hardcoded this campaign to F:/Prometheus-worktrees via ops/round_clock.py:45-54, and ops/residue.py would classify any worker outside that table as FOREIGN_REPO and stop it. The in-process path avoids that trap entirely.
e01 requires neither GPU nor Redis - only a git worktree and PM_TAG. That is the most portable an experiment in this ecosystem currently gets.
Smoking the instrument before spending budget caught 6 defects, 4 of which would have produced a false retention effect. This should become a deterministic gate (CW01-D013, CW01-D015).
